name: Aanya Kapoor
bio: Early riser who loves cooking big weekend breakfasts. I keep shared spaces tidy and I'm always up for a movie night.

prompts.prompt: You'll find me in the kitchen making…
prompts.answer: Pancakes for the whole house every Saturday morning.

prompts.prompt: The one house rule I'd never break…
prompts.answer: Dishes done the same day. Always.

prompts.prompt: My ideal Friday night is…
prompts.answer: Takeaway, a board game and a film we argue about.

name: Rohan Mehta
bio: Quiet during the week, social on weekends. I play guitar (with headphones!) and make a mean dal.

prompts.prompt: I'm studying / working on…
prompts.answer: A PhD on making AI models smaller and faster.

prompts.prompt: My biggest pet peeve in a shared house…
prompts.answer: Loud calls in the kitchen at midnight.

prompts.prompt: Something I'm weirdly good at…
prompts.answer: Making dal that converts anyone to lentils.

name: Saoirse O'Brien
bio: Tea enthusiast and bookworm. I'd love a housemate who's respectful of quiet hours but also up for the odd pub quiz.

prompts.prompt: On a lazy Sunday I'm usually…
prompts.answer: Reading in a window seat with a pot of tea and my cat.

prompts.prompt: My go-to way to sort out a disagreement…
prompts.answer: Talk it out over tea, not in the group chat.

prompts.prompt: A small thing that makes my day…
prompts.answer: Someone else emptying the dishwasher.

name: Liam Fitzgerald
bio: Gym in the morning, study during the day, Netflix at night. Pretty chill about most things as long as the kitchen stays clean.

prompts.prompt: The best way to win me over is…
prompts.answer: A clean kitchen and a gym buddy at 7am.

prompts.prompt: My ideal Friday night is…
prompts.answer: Pizza and a Netflix series I've already seen twice.

prompts.prompt: Something I'm weirdly good at…
prompts.answer: Taking photos of people when they're not looking.

name: Cian Murphy
bio: I spend half my life in the studio so the house is always tidy by default. Love a Sunday roast with housemates.

prompts.prompt: You'll find me in the kitchen making…
prompts.answer: A Sunday roast for anyone who's around.

prompts.prompt: I'm studying / working on…
prompts.answer: Architecture, so I basically live in the studio.

prompts.prompt: My ideal Friday night is…
prompts.answer: A gig in town, then chips on the way home.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Organised and easy-going. I'm a morning person who likes the house quiet after 11pm. Big fan of farmers' markets.

prompts.prompt: The one house rule I'd never break…
prompts.answer: Quiet after 11pm on weeknights.

prompts.prompt: On a lazy Sunday I'm usually…
prompts.answer: At the farmers' market, then baking whatever I bought.

prompts.prompt: A small thing that makes my day…
prompts.answer: A tidy fridge with everyone's food labelled.

name: Éabha Walsh
bio: First year of living away from home. I'm friendly, a decent cook, and I promise to always do my dishes.

prompts.prompt: The best way to win me over is…
prompts.answer: Coffee. Any coffee. I'm not fussy.

prompts.prompt: My go-to way to sort out a disagreement…
prompts.answer: Say it straight, then go for a walk together.

prompts.prompt: Something I'm weirdly good at…
prompts.answer: Speedrunning old video games.

name: Tadhg O'Sullivan
bio: Mature student, calm and collected. Happy to cook together or do our own thing. Early to bed, early to rise.

prompts.prompt: The one house rule I'd never break…
prompts.answer: Leave the place as you'd want to find it.

prompts.prompt: On a lazy Sunday I'm usually…
prompts.answer: Out hiking with the dog, then a GAA match on telly.

prompts.prompt: I'm studying / working on…
prompts.answer: Becoming a secondary school teacher after years in retail.
